description: Sensitivity of ArogyaTwin's expiry/trust layer to underlying opportunistic relay strategy. Compares three DTN routing protocols (Epidemic, binary Spray-and-Wait, PRoPHET) with and without ArogyaTwin per-packet expiry check. Separate from the main 30-trial experiment.

modes.expiry_aware: ArogyaTwin TTL expiry applied before relay

relationship_to_main_experiment: SEPARATE. Main experiment: 30 trials, seeds 8000-8029, run_trial() in engine.py. DTN experiment: 15 trials, seeds 7000-7014, run_protocol() in dtn.py.
